items.title: Art Farmer — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The radio. At that time, dance bands were on the radio all the time, like Benny Goodman and Duke Ellington.

ctx.x: [Laughs] So, you were learning music both taking lessons and hearing it in the church, what other music were you hearing growing up?

The radio. At that time, dance bands were on the radio all the time, like Benny Goodman and Duke Ellington. There was always some broadcast going on, on the radio. Dance music was the pop music of that time, speaking of the 30s and the 40s, so that’s what everyone was listening to.
Do you remember where those broadcasts were coming from?
